snippet.title: Midnight | Intercession Cinematic | World of Warcraft
snippet.description:
As Midnight draws near, Xal'atath’s ravenous void armies descend upon Silvermoon, threatening to envelop all of Azeroth in eternal darkness. 

Take up arms and stand against the Devouring Host in the next chapter of the Worldsoul Saga -- World of Warcraft: Midnight
